book.title: Rongamwahu me Ntingdier sang rehn MARK

content: Mehn Nasaret Kasohwe Sises
Sises ahpw ketisang wasao, ketilahng nan uhdahn sapwellime kahnimw, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw iangala.

Ni eh lel rahnen Sapado, e ahpw tapihada padahk nan sinakokeo. Mie me tohto me mi wasao ahpw pwuriamweikihla ni ar kin rong sapwellime padahk. Re ahpw ndapene nanpwungarail, “Ohl menet ale sang ia soahng pwukat koaros? Soangen kupwurokong da ieu met me mi reh? Ia duwen eh kak wia soangen manaman pwukat?
Kaidehkin ih kapinteo met, nein Mery, rien Seims, Soses, Sudas oh Saimon? Kaidehkin rie lih me kin mihmi rehtail kan?” Irail eri kasohwehki.
A Sises ahpw ketin mahsanihong irail, “Wasa koaros soukohp kin waun ie, ihte wasa me sohte wauwi kin mie, nan uhdake, rehn sawi, oh rehn tohnimwe kan.”
Iei me e sohte kak wiahkihda manaman ehu nan uhdakeo, ahpw me soumwahu kei me e ketikidahng pohrail lime ko oh ketin kakehleirailda.
E ahpw ketin pwuriamweikihla ar seupwoson. Sises ketin Poaronepeseng me Ehk Riemeno (Pil tehk Mad. 10.5-15; Luk 9.1-6) Sises eri ketin pahngseli kisin kahnimw kan, padapadahk ong aramas akan.
Mwuhr, e ahpw malipepene me ehk riemeno, oh poaroneirailpeseng wad riemen. E ketikihong irail manaman en powehdi ngehn saut akan,
oh ketin kehkehlingkihong irail, re dehpa wa mehkot nan ar seiloak wet, ihte sokontehpwoat; re dehpa wa kisin mwenge, de edin seiloak, de mwohni nan ar pwekid kan.
Re kak suht, ahpw re dehpa sekid riau mehn kiemmad.
E pil mahsanihong irail, “Ni amwail pahn lel ni kahnimw ehu, kumwail keikeiruhte rehn me kasamwoikumwaillong nan imwarail kan, kumwail lao mweselsang wasao.
A wasa kis me re sohte men kasamwo kumwail de sohte men rong kumwail, kumwail sipedasang pwelen nehmwail kan ni amwail pahn mweselsang wasao, mehn kapehm ehu met ong irail!”
Me ehk riemeno eri mweselpeseng oh tapihada kapahrengkihong aramas koaros re en koluhla oh wiliakapwala.
Re kausasang ngehn suwed tohto rehn aramas akan oh keiehki leh me soumwahu tohto oh kakehleirailda.
Kamakamalahn Sohn Sounpapidais
Nanmwarki Erod karongehda mepwukat koaros, pwe Sises ndandla wasa koaros. Ekei ndinda me Sohn Sounpapidais me mourda sapahl, oh ihme e kak wiahki manaman pwukat.
A ekei dene Elaisa. Ekei ndinda me soukohp emen ih, duwehte emen soukohp en kawa ko.
Ni Erod eh karongehda met, e ahpw mahsanih, “Ih Sohn Sounpapidais met, me I lupukasang moangeo, e ahpw mourda sapahl.”
Pwe Erod poaronelahng Sohn en selidi, oh mahsanih en lekdekiong nan imweteng pwehki Erodias en rie Pilip eh pwoud, me Erod uhd pwoudikihda.
Sohn Sounpapidais sohte kin tokedihsang kapwukapwungohng Erod eh sapwung, mahsanih, “E sohte mweimweiong komwi en ale en riomwio eh pwoud!”
Ihme Erodias kailongkilahki mehlel Sohn, oh men kemehla; ahpw sohte kak;

pwe Erod kin lehn Sohn, pwe e mwahngih me ohl pwung oh sarawi men ih. Ihme e kin ketin kasilehkihsang soahng suwed kan oh kin perenki karonge eh mahsen kan, mehnda ma nan kupwure kin toutoula ahnsou koaros ni eh kin karonge.

Eri, Erodias ahpw diarada eh ahnsou mwahu ieu ni rahnen ipwidien Erod. Pwe rahno Erod ketin wiahda kamadipw ehu ong sapwellime soumas akan, ong kaunen sapwellime karis ko, oh pil ong me lapalap en wehin Kalili.

Eri, nein Erodias nah serepein ahpw pwarodo oh kahkahlek ni kamadipwo; Erod oh tohnkamadipwo eri perenkihda kowahlap. Iei me nanmwarkio mahsanihkihong Serepeino, “Mie mehkot me ke anahne? Peki rehi, pwe I pahn kihong uhk.”
E ahpw pil kahula, mahsanih, “Samat Koht nanleng, I pahn kihwei mehkot sohte lipilipil me ke pahn peki rehi, mehnda ma pil apalien ei wehi.”
Serepeino eri pedoila idek rehn eh nohno, nda, “Ino, dahme I pahn peki?” A eh nohno ahpw sapeng, nda, “Moangen Sohn Sounpapidais.”
Serepeino eri pwuralahng rehn nanmwarkio, patohwanohng, “I men komwi en ketikidohng ie ahnsou wet moangen Sohn Sounpapidais nan ehu dahlen!”
Met ahpw katoutouwihala kupwur en nanmwarkio; e ahpw sohte men kansensuwedihala serepeino pwehki eh ketin inou ong mwohn tohnkamadipwo koaros.
Ih eri mwadang poaronehla sapwellime sounpei men, mahsanih pwe moangen Sohn Sounpapidais en wisikdo. Sounpeio eri kohlahte lupukasang moangen Sohno nan imwetengo.
E ahpw pwurodo wa moangeo nan dahl ehu, e ahpw kihong serepeino; serepeino ahpw uhd kihong eh nohno.
Ni nein Sohn tohnpadahk ko ar karongehda met, re ahpw pwarala ale kahlepeo nekidediong nan sousou ehu.
Sises ketin Katungoale Ohl Limekid
Mwurin wahnpoaron ko ar pwurpene, re ahpw pokonpene rehn Sises pwe re en kasalehiong mehkoaros me re wiadahr oh padahk koaros me re kawehwedahr.

Aramas tohtohie me kin pwurupwure Sises oh sapwellime tohnpadahk ko kahrehda eh solahr ahnsoun ar konot. Iei me Sises mahsanihkihong wahnpoaron ko, “Kitail kohla kalapwukala mahs nan sapwtehno, wasa kumwail kak kommoal ie.”
Irail eri ketidahng pohn pwoht ehu pwe re en kolahng kalapwukala wasa kis.
A aramas tohto kilangirailda ni arail mweselo oh esehda. Irail eri sapallahng wasao sang ni kahnimw koaros oh lel wasao mwohrail.

Ni Sises eh ketidihsang pohn pwohto, e ahpw mahsanihada lapalahn pokon ehu, e ahpw kupwurohkinirailla. Pwe re rasehng pelin sihpw ehu me sohte silepe. Ih eri ketin tapihada kawehwehiong irail soahng tohto.
Wasa lao soutikpene, sapwellime tohnpadahk ko ahpw patohdo reh, patohwanohng, “Maing, wasa pwongier oh sapwtehn ehu met.
Komw ketin kadarpeseng pokon wet, pwe re en pahngewei kisin kahnimw oh kousapw keren kan oh pein pwainda kanarail kisin mwenge.”
Sises ahpw ketin sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail nek katungoale irail.” A irail patohwanohng, “Eri, se en patolahng pwainda kisin sak me uwe pahn pahrekiong mwohni silper riepwiki
oh katungoalehkin irail?”
Sises ahpw ketin keinemwe, “Lopwon en pilawa depe mie rehmwail? Kumwail kilang oh wadek.” Ni ar wadekadahr, re ahpw patohwanohng, “Me limau oh pil mwahmw riemen.”
Sises eri mahsanihong tohnpadahk ko, re en wiahkihda kisin pwihn kei pokono oh kamwohdangiraildiong pohn reh kan.
Re ahpw mwohndi ni pwihn kei, ekei wad epwiki, a ekei wad limehk.

Sises eri ketikihda lopwon en pilawa limawo oh mwahmw riemeno, mahsendalahng nanleng oh kapingkalahngankiong Koht. E ahpw piltikihpeseng pilawa ko oh ketikihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko pwe re en nehkohng aramas ako. E pil ketin nehkohng irail koaros mwahmw riemeno.
Irail koaros ahpw kepin konot oh medla.
Tohnpadahk ko ahpw deukada kopwou eisek riau, luhwen pilawa ko oh mwahmw riemeno.
Ohl me iang kepin konotki pilawa ko, irail me limekid.
Sises ketin Alu Pohn Leho
Mwurin met Sises ahpw mwadang mahsanihong sapwellime tohnpadahk ko, re en karadahng pohn pwoht ehu oh tiengla mwowe kolahng Pedsaida, palio leho, nindokon eh pahn ketin kadarpeseng pokono.
Ni eh ketin kadarirailpeseng, e ahpw ketidalahng pohn dohl ehu pwe en loulou ie.
Ni eh wasa soutikpene, pwohto miher nanwerengen leho, a Sises ketin kalakalapwuk ni oaroahro.

E ketin mahsanihada duwen tohnpadahk ko ar pedipedieng oh raraungki ar padil nan leho. Eri, kodahng nin sohrahn, nanpwungen kulok siluh oh weneu, e ahpw ketila rehrail, ketiket kohla pohn leho. Likamwete e pahn daulih irail,
a re kilangada duwen eh ketin alialu pohn leho, re kihkihong me eni men.
Ihme ihr koaros mwoarongkihda oh masepwehkada ni ar kilangada Sises. Ih eri mwadangete mahsenlahng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwail koapworopwor! Kumwail dehr masak! Ngehi met.”
Ih eri ketidahng pohn pwohto iangirailla; ahnsowohte e pa mwelehdi. Tohnpadahk ko ahpw malamalawangkihla kowahlap.
Pwe re sohte mwahn dehdehki manaman me Sises ketin katungoalehki aramas limekido, pwe loalarail wie rotorotete.
Sises ketin Kakehlahda me Soumwahu kan en Kenesaret
Irail eri kotehla leho, inenlahng Kenesaret oh peidi limwahn sahpwo.
Ni ar keredi sang pohn pwohto, aramas akan mwadangete esehda Sises.
Re ahpw tangpeseng wasa koaros tapihada wadohng rehn Sises me soumwahu kan pohn mehn roh kan wasa me re rong me e ketiket ie.

Oh wasa koaros me e kin ketila ie, nan kisin kahnimw kan, de nan kousapw akan, de nan kahnimw lap akan, aramas akan kin pwilikihdi nair soumwahu kan nanial akan, oh peki en ketin mweidohng pwe re en doahke pwungipen sapwellime likowo. Eri, irail koaros me kin sair sapwellime likowo kin kehlailda sang ar soumwahu kan.

footnotes.text: MWOHNI SILPER: Ehu mwohni silper iei pweinen tohndoadoahk men rahn ehu ni ahnsowo (tehk Mad. 20.2).
